## Invitations

A total of 450 invitations were issued for the River Districts 2022 Q3 outreach activity. Attendance was recorded at 51 people, giving an attendance rate of 11.3. The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and participation recorded during the reporting period. They are presented together to support a clear comparison between the number invited and the number who attended.

The attendance figure represents those recorded as present following the invitation process. No further interpretation of attendance is included in this report.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 401 were accompanied by an SMS. This was the principal recorded contact method used alongside the invitation process. The records show that 0 reminder messages were received. This figure is reported as recorded and does not indicate that additional reminders were sent through another channel.

The contact figures are provided with the invitation and attendance figures to give a concise account of outreach activity, participation, and follow-up communication for the reporting period.

Prepared by G. Evans.
